summary: The diff implements all three requirements comprehensively. REQ-1 is addressed via conditional Admin Panel link in Layout.tsx and the LockerAccessAdmin page. REQ-2 is addressed via backend persistence (main.mo), useLockerAccessRequests hooks, and LockerAccessRequestsPanel with approve/deny. REQ-3 is addressed via LockerAccessGate with distinct UI states for unauthenticated, pending, denied, approved, and admin users.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration module (backend/migration.mo) was added that removes lastDocumentId and lastLinkId fields from the actor state as part of migration.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention any data migration or removal of lastDocumentId/lastLinkId fields. The constraint says not to change existing backend data types or storage maps unless required to fix the access request persistence bug.
